name: marketing-06
title: Docs site
description: A Wickerline docs site in one component: a home with one search across every page and three category cards, then pages with the sidebar, a page header, install steps whose package manager rolls the command, callouts, a table of events, an On this page rail and previous and next links. A small router keeps the state, and a search for install opens the page while bun rolls into the command.
